name: screen-ocr
description: 截屏 OCR 工具：截取屏幕任意区域，本地识别文字并支持划选复制

scripts.test: node tests/test_i18n.js && node tests/test_i18n_scan.js && node tests/test_crop_math.js
scripts.test:ui: electron tests/test_result_ui.js && electron tests/test_i18n_ui.js && electron tests/test_settings.js
scripts.build-py: pyinstaller python/ocr_server.py --onedir --name ocr_server --distpath python/ocr_pkg --workpath build/pyi --noconfirm --collect-all rapidocr --collect-all onnxruntime
